What is an Activity Picker?

An Activity Picker is a fun tool that helps you discover what to do when you're bored. With 80+ activities across 8 categories, it takes the "I don't know what to do" out of your day. Whether you're looking for something active, creative, social, or relaxing, we've got options for every mood.

When to Use the Activity Picker

  • • When you're bored and need inspiration
  • • Planning family activities for the weekend
  • • Finding new hobbies to try
  • • Breaking out of a routine rut
  • • Group activities when friends are over

Pros

  • ✓ 80+ built-in activities across 8 categories
  • ✓ Filter by category for targeted results
  • ✓ Instant inspiration without overthinking
  • ✓ Perfect for all ages and group sizes
  • ✓ Discover new hobbies you never tried

Considerations

  • • Results depend on selected categories
  • • Some activities may require materials
  • • Not all activities suit all ages
  • • Consider weather and location constraints

Frequently Asked Questions

What categories are available?

We have 8 categories: Creative Arts, Outdoor Adventures, Sports & Fitness, Social Games, Learning & Reading, Music & Entertainment, Wellness & Relaxation, and Food & Cooking.

Can I pick from all categories at once?

Yes! Click the main "Get Random Activity" button to pick from all 80+ activities. Or select specific categories to narrow down to activities you prefer.

Are the activities suitable for kids?

Many activities are family-friendly, but some categories like "Social Games" or "Outdoor Adventures" have options for all ages. Filter by category to find appropriate activities.

Let inspiration guide your day

Use the Activity Picker to Teach Exploration and Openness

The Activity Picker is perfect for teaching kids that trying new things doesn't have to be scary. When your child says "I don't know what to do," let the picker decide. This removes the pressure of choice and introduces the idea that exploration is valuable even when you don't know what you'll discover. It's great for reducing "I'm bored" syndrome and building a growth mindset around novelty.

Questions Parents Ask

What should we do today when nobody has ideas?

That 'I don't know, what do YOU want to do' loop is a choice problem, not a boredom problem. The activity picker offers a concrete suggestion to react to — and even a 'no, not that' brings you one step closer to what everyone actually wants.

Are the activities kid-friendly?

Yes — the picker draws from family-friendly indoor and outdoor activities that need little or no equipment. Spin again as often as you like until something sparks.

Is the activity picker free?

Free, no signup, on any device. Great for rainy Saturdays, school breaks, and the witching hour before dinner.
